name: PowerTel
summary: PowerTel Limited (ASX: PWT) — Australia's second-largest fixed broadband and inter-city fibre carrier; built the ~2500km Melbourne-to-Brisbane backbone; acquired Request Broadband (2004) and NTT Australia (2004); absorbed into AAPT (Telecom NZ) May 2007 (POWERTEL LIMITED, ACN 001 760 103).

events.details: Acquired by Telecom NZ (A$357m incl. debt, $2.30/share) for the AAPT group; PowerTel name retired.
